import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
# baseline: all dates except anomaly date
base = df[df['date']!='2025-10-13']
anom = df[df['date']=='2025-10-13']

# per-row baseline: group by csp, cloud_service, application, instance_family
g = base.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']).agg(
    mean_cost=('unblended_cost','mean'),
    std_cost=('unblended_cost','std'),
    n=('unblended_cost','count')).reset_index()

a = anom.copy()
m = a.merge(g, on=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'], how='left')
m['delta'] = m['unblended_cost'] - m['mean_cost']
m = m.sort_values('delta', ascending=False)
print(m[['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family','unblended_cost','mean_cost','std_cost','delta']].head(20).to_string())
print("total delta:", m['delta'].sum())

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
base = df[df['date']!='2025-10-13']
anom = df[df['date']=='2025-10-13'].copy()

m = m.merge(g2, on=['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])

top = m.sort_values('mean', ascending=False).head(5)
for _, r in top.iterrows():

    print((r.csp,r.cloud_service,r.application,r.instance_family), "min/max/last:", s.min(), s.max(), list(s.items())[-3:])"}
